title: Belgravia, Athlone (approx.): woman, 65, and man shot dead, 10 Oct
summary: Police say a 65-year-old woman and an adult man were shot dead in Belgravia, Athlone, on Saturday 10 October at about 19:00; a third person was wounded and taken to hospital. Police spokesperson Wesley Twigg said the mot...
story: Police say a 65-year-old woman and an adult man were shot dead in Belgravia, Athlone, on Saturday 10 October at about 19:00; a third person was wounded and taken to hospital. Police spokesperson Wesley Twigg said the motive is believed to be gang-related (SABC News). No arrests had been made by 11 October (Cape Town ETC). Neither source gives a street.
location_note: Belgravia, Athlone. Suburb only, so the pin is the suburb's map point, not the scene.

provenance.note: Two reports written separately, both resting on police. SABC quotes Sgt Wesley Twigg; Cape Town ETC cites police without naming a spokesperson for this shooting. Its Van Wyk quote is about the earlier 6 Oct Belgravia Road shooting. Neither has a non-police source.
